shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight via Fedex Ground or Home Delivery. We do not use Express or overnight shipping. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight. These are Fedex rules, not ours. We try to ship items the day after receiving payment. Payments must be received by 7:00 am to be shipped that day. After 7:00 am the item(s) will ship the following day. We generally do not work weekends and therefore shipping is not done on those days.
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
We put ADULT SIGNATURE REQUIRED on your package delivery if your order totals more than $100.00 excluding, tax, handling and shipping. Items under the value of $100.00 will NOT be receiving the signature option. This is to help prevent porch theft and to minimize lost packages. We are doing this for you, the buyer. This requirement is in your best interest and at no cost to you. We are paying for this surcharge and it is our way of giving back to you to ensure you receive your item(s).
If you would prefer not to have the signature requirement, please contact us by opening a service ticket to let us know that you would not prefer it
. If you place your item on hold for pickup at any Fedex location that has Adult Signature Required, you will be required to show ID but your address on the ID must match the ship to address on the label.
Regarding lost or delayed packages: If a package has been or is being delayed (non-movement on the tracking number after 2-4 days), please notify us by opening a customer service ticket for your shipped item. We will, in turn, file a claim on our behalf with Fedex for your package. This will trigger a search for your package, if found by Fedex, your package will start moving again. If not found, Fedex will pay the claim. When Fedex marks the claim as paid in their system, we will then issue your refund, not before, no exceptions. This process can take 2-4 weeks to resolve. We check on claim statuses Monday - Friday and will issue your refund accordingly.
REMINDER:
If you place your item on hold for pickup at a Fedex location, you have 7 days (including weekends) to pick up your package. Failure to pick up your package at the hold location results in the package being returned to us. You will then have to pay new shipping charges if you want your item re-shipped. If not, the item is then considered a donation and there will be no refunds issued under any circumstances.
Fedex does not deliver to PO Boxes
. You must provide a physical street address. If you have a PO Box setup on your account that you use, you may modify your SHIP TO ADDRESS when submitting your payment.
WE DO NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS
. We strongly urge users to estimate shipping before bidding. We do not lower or alter FedEx rates and will not cancel orders for shipping cost reasons.

description:
Maxell XLII 90
High Bias Type II Blank Audio Cassettes
Lot of 3 Sealed Tapes
The Maxell XLII is an iconic Type II high-bias cassette formulation renowned for its low noise, wide dynamic range, and consistent high-frequency response. Featuring the classic packaging with the legendary Steve Steigman "Blown Away" chair visual, these tapes were designed specifically to capture the clarity of digital audio and CD sources. Manufactured in Japan, Maxell XLII cassettes remain highly sought after by vintage audio enthusiasts and recording hobbyists.
High Bias IEC Type II formulation with 70s equalization
90 minutes total recording time (2 x 45 minutes) / 135 meters (443 feet)
Lot includes 3 individually factory-sealed blank audio cassette tapes in original cellophane
Made in Japan as indicated on rear packaging
Condition:
All three cassette tapes are brand new and factory sealed in original manufacturer shrink wrap. The clear plastic wrap is fully intact on each tape with no tears, holes, or unsealed seams. Jewel cases and internal j-cards appear pristine beneath the wrap.

All merchandise is sold in
AS IS
condition. Items are represented to the best of our ability,

completing payment

All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.

NOT
experts in any field. All gemstones are measured using electronic calipers.

Items may be vintage, antique or newer. There is still a chance that the stones can become loose or that a connector may need to be tightened. No refunds permitted or given for gemstones that become dislodged from their setting in or during shipment.

The definition of the word
stone(s)

Unless specifically stated as gemstone(s) there will be no returns accepted for jewelry where the word "stone(s)" is used in our listing. Please make sure you understand and take that into account before placing a bid.
Pearls are tested to the best of our ability for texture and layering. They are not professionally tested. Pearls that do not pass the texture and layering test are labeled "faux". The approximate diameter is provided for size only, and the pearl(s) may or may not be perfectly round. 90% of the world's pearls are now cultured and are not naturally occurring. We cannot distinguish between cultured and natural pearls. You are bidding with this knowledge in mind.
Color, when we describe the color (of a stone, gem, bead, or anything that is described by a color), we may have different lighting than you & some of us see colors differently. Please know that the color that is described could be slightly different & a return will not be accepted for this reason.

Items sold AS IS, with no refunds on functionality.

This vintage Mexican folk art lot includes three decorative pieces inspired by Mesoamerican iconography. The group features a hand-modeled terracotta clay effigy pipe sculpted in Pre-Columbian style, alongside two mid-century Artaluxpan enameled wood plaques illustrating Aztec calendar deities.
ITEMS INCLUDED:

- Artaluxpan Mexico, polychrome enamel inlay on wood, labeled on reverse
3.
Enamel Plaque (Seated Deity)
- Polychrome enamel inlay on wood, depicting seated figure with offering vessel

shipping.policy:
1. Items from our selling location will ship within 5-7 business days (Excluding weekends & Holidays) from the time payment is received. We are working as fast and safely as possible to ensure all orders are shipped out in a timely manner.
2. We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.
6.
Can not combine Buy Now Items (due to system limitations)
6. If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt automatically to combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically prompt please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry some exceptions may be made.
7. Goodwill Industries of Orange County will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with carrier for these types of situations.
8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
9. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

This handcrafted Tree of Life suncatcher by Scout Curated Wears combines natural gemstone artistry with light-refracting crystal display design. Configured as the Tree of Protection, the piece features natural amethyst chips and faceted crystal beads woven across gold-tone brass wire branches. The tree is anchored to a heavy multi-faceted clear crystal sphere designed to cast vibrant rainbow light across interior living spaces when placed in direct sunlight.
Handcrafted brass wire tree with natural amethyst and crystal accent beads

Complete with original Scout Curated Wears cylindrical storage container
Condition:
Glass crystal base is clear and free of cracks, chips, or scratches. Wire armature and gemstone chips are intact with no loose or missing elements. Storage cylinder is structurally sound with light handling wear along the cardboard rim.
